:''Not to be confused with Duplica's second Ditto, {{DL|Duplica|Mini-Dit}}''. ---- {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Normal| trainername=Duplica| jtrainername=イミテ| tmtrainername=Imite| pokemonname=Ditto| jpokemonname=メタモン| tmpokemonname=Metamon| image=[[File:Duplica Ditto.png|250px]] | caption=Duplica's Ditto | location=[[Kanto]]
{{rt|13|Kanto}} ([[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] only) | numeps1=an unknown number of | firststagename=Ditto| prevonum=132| noevo=incap | epnum=EP037| epname=Ditto's Mysterious Mansion| current=[[Party|With Duplica]]| java1=[[Kotono Mitsuishi]]| enva1=[[Rachael Lillis]]| }} '''Duplica's Ditto''' (Japanese: '''イミテのメタモン''' ''Imite's Metamon'') is [[Duplica]]'s main [[Pokémon]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== [[Duplica]]'s Ditto first appeared in ''[[EP037|Ditto's Mysterious Mansion]]'' in the form of a {{p|Pikachu}} while playing with {{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}. However, its face was different to other Pikachu, leading the others to believe that it was a new [[Pokémon (species)|species]]. Excited, {{Ash}} tried to capture it, but Duplica revealed herself and that her Pokémon was in fact a {{p|Ditto}}. Ash doubted Ditto's ability in {{pkmn|battle}}, but accepted Duplica's challenge. However, Ditto quickly rendered [[Ash's Bulbasaur]] immobile with {{m|Vine Whip}}, causing Ash to forfeit the match. Duplica revealed that unlike most Ditto, hers could not change its face when it {{m|transform}}ed into other Pokémon, which was holding them back from becoming famous, as the Ditto face disappointed her audience. {{TRT}} promptly decided to steal Ditto, coax it into the shape of a {{p|Dratini}}, and present it to {{an|Giovanni}} as a gift. With help from {{TP|James|Weezing}}, they succeeded in stealing Ditto. However, Ditto was incapable of meeting their demands, transforming into a mutation between a man and a Dratini instead and then into a book instead of the Dratini pictured. When forced to turn into a {{p|Meowth}}, Ditto was so intimidated that it rubbed its face and transformed correctly. Ash, Duplica, and the others then turned up at Team Rocket's hiding place, where they were confronted by identical Meowth. Team Rocket tried to pass off {{MTR}} as Ditto whilst they escaped, but Duplica could tell the difference despite the transformation. Duplica threw Meowth at Team Rocket, causing Ditto to fall free. It transformed into a cannon and blasted Pikachu at the balloon, who caused Team Rocket to blast off. Now that Ditto could transform perfectly, Duplica reopened her theater for performances. It made a cameo appearance with Duplica in the [[original series]]' second Japanese opening theme, [[The Rivals]], and its English dub equivalent, {{so|Pokémon World}}. ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== Ditto reappeared in ''[[EP174|Imitation Confrontation]]'', disguised as a {{p|Chansey}}. Once {{an|Brock}} caught Duplica out for impersonating [[Nurse Joy]], Duplica revealed herself and told the group that they were there for an acting competition. Once Duplica's new Ditto, Mini-Dit, was stolen, Ditto transformed into {{p|Noctowl}} to help search, but to no avail. When the group did discover Team Rocket, Ditto transformed into {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and used {{m|Wrap}} to keep Weezing out of the battle. It then transformed back into Pikachu and teamed up with Ash's Pikachu and Mini-Dit in the form of Pikachu to send Team Rocket blasting off with {{m|Thunder}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== Ditto is the master of transforming into many other species, including items as shown when Ditto was in {{TRT}}'s custody during its first appearance. At first, when Ditto transformed, the transformed being retained Ditto's face. This happened until {{MTR}} wiped it off and retained the face of the Pokémon it transformed into. Duplica used Ditto and its ability to transform to perform in a show in a Pokémon Center. After the show, {{an|Misty}} congratulates them on their great performance. Misty also showed extreme interest in catching a Ditto despite her being a {{type|Water}} Trainer, much to Ditto's nervousness. While [[Ash Ketchum (EToP)|Ash]], {{an|Brock}}, [[A.J.]] and the [[Samurai]] talk about a hidden village they plan on going to, Misty and Duplica go over to tell them that they intend on going out so Misty can catch a Ditto of her own. When Ash mocks her for wanting a Ditto, Misty has Ditto transform into a poor imitation of Ash, so she can beat him up, while acting like she has no idea which is which. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Normal||Duplica Ditto Transform {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Machoke|1=Ash}} EToP.png|Using Transform}} {{anmov|normal|Transform|ET07|Pikachu's Excellent Adventure}} {{anmov/f|Normal}} ==Trivia== * {{p|Ditto}}'s habit of not transforming its face was originally presented as an anomaly.
